cc:Work.dc:title: CPU inference: original vs optimized AVX-512
cc:Work.dc:description: Ryzen 9 9950X3D · 4 physical cores on 96 MiB L3 · 30 s audio / 128 forced tokens 16 validation clips · 3 sustained windows per implementation · 480 timed clips total Energy: mean of window-level J/clip; whiskers show the observed window range, not a confidence interval. Latency: pooled clip p50 and p95. CPU package energy includes uncore and other host activity. Seeded random weights: execution benchmark; speech recognition quality was not evaluated. summary.json SHA256: d2f991bef3a46bdc31f4c525fbbcf47a1fa0297e8308fc1a8c66f0b1fc3a126f Rendered with matplotlib 3.11.2
